address: Speckbacherstrasse 1, Sankt Johann in Tirol, 6380, Austria
bio: It's easy to see why this traditional spot in the very centre of town is so popular. Its classic tavern cooking is a major draw – favourites such as Frittatensuppe (pancake strips in broth), beef goulash with bread dumplings, or Wiener schnitzel are staples here. The lovely modern Alpine-style dining rooms with light wood panelling and the friendly service add to the appeal.
